result.title: Solver to System: LLM Reasoning Across Representations and Execution in Scientific Simulation
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models. 23 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables
result.summary: Simulators based on partial differential equations (PDEs) are widely used to model physical systems, but generating and interpreting PDE solver code with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. Scientific simulation code is a useful testbed for LLM scientific reasoning because (1) one system can be represented by code, equations, natural language, and numerical trajectories and (2) code can execute successfully while implementing invalid physics. We introduce Solver2System, a dataset of PDE solvers with multiple representations, controlled corruptions, and lexical perturbations, to evaluate whether LLMs can recover the underlying physical system through (1) cross-representation consistency and (2) static and agentic detection of physical invalidity. Across eight open-weight models, LLMs systematically favor some representations when evidence conflicts, and lexical perturbations to code alter interpretation of other unchanged representations. Execution improves physical-validity judgments, but weaker agents can judge correctly without identifying the causal defect. Thus, LLMs may reach correct judgments despite inconsistent representation reconciliation or causal misdiagnosis.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 Solver2System 数据集，用 PDE 求解器代码、方程、自然语言与数值轨迹等多表征及受控损坏，评测八个开源模型能否经跨表征一致性与物理有效性检测还原真实系统。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「判断正确但因果诊断错误」及证据冲突下的表征偏好，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否真被使用、答案与内部状态脱节；但对象为科学模拟而非视觉，迁移性待评估。
